item.title: Blueprint James Livingston 5 Update
item.description:
7Please note that construction schedules are subject to change due to weather, site issues, etc. 

Unsure about which is your area? Visit the Blueprint map and enter your address to find out! 

Sump pump installations are offered for a limited time only! Contact us and we’ll get you on the waitlist for your no-obligation assessment!

Reminder: If you have a basement backup (sewer water coming up from your floor drain), please report this to the City by calling 614-645-7102. Please note that crews are working diligently to investigate issues throughout the city, so response will not be immediate. We appreciate your patience and understanding. 

James Livingston 5 Construction Update - As of November 24, 2025

No work will take place on Thursday or Friday of this week.

Main Line Cleaning

  • MES Crews will be cleaning near:
    • Baxter
    • Dundee
    • Aragon
    • Amesbury
    • Rodney
    • Grimsby

Main Line Lining/CIPP (Cured-in-Place Pipe):

  • Inliner crew will be working along:
    • Lattimer
    • Beatrice

Have a question or concern about construction?  Give us a call at 614-645-1253 or email blueprint@columbus.gov.
